context: Two teens compare their term schedules in the hallway
purpose: Teach: 月曜日/火曜日/三月/校長/分間/半ば/長男/国語

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、新学期の時間割もう見た？私、月曜日朝が地獄なんだけど。
lines.en: Hey, did you see the new schedule? Monday mornings are hell for me.
lines.style: Casual teen girl, slightly whiny opener with hallway energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た。俺も毎週火曜日に体育が二コマ連続で入っててマジ無理。
lines.en: Yeah I saw. I've got two PE blocks every Tuesday, no way.
lines.style: Casual teen boy, complaining with exaggerated frustration

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ最悪じゃん。あと国語の授業が三月末までずっと古文らしいよ。
lines.en: Ugh that sucks. And apparently Japanese class is all classical lit through March.
lines.style: Sympathetic then dropping bad news, conversational teen tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: え、三月半ばの試験範囲そこまで？校長先生の朝礼でも言ってたっけ？
lines.en: Wait, the mid-March exam covers all that? Did the principal mention it at assembly?
lines.style: Surprised teen boy, double-checking with rising intonation

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 言ってたよ。十分間運動の後にちょろっと。聞いてなかったでしょ。
lines.en: He did, right after the ten-minute exercise. You weren't listening, were you.
lines.style: Teasing accusatory teen girl, mildly exasperated

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まあな。うちの長男が高三で受験ピリピリしてるから、家でも勉強の話ばっかでうんざりなんだよ。
lines.en: Fair. The oldest brother is a senior cramming, so it's nonstop study talk at home.
lines.style: Teen boy venting about family pressure, world-weary

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あー分かる。お兄ちゃんいると比べられるよね。とりあえず放課後カラオケ行かない？
lines.en: Ah I get it. Older siblings invite comparisons. Anyway, wanna hit karaoke after school?
lines.style: Empathetic pivot to plans, upbeat teen girl invitation

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 行く行く。古文の予習は次の月曜日の朝にやればいいや。
lines.en: Definitely. I'll just cram the classical lit next Monday morning.
lines.style: Enthusiastic agreement, classic teen procrastinator logic
